videos.desc: A woman in an orange jumper films herself while holding a yellow umbrella high above her head so the group behind her can see it. She walks backwards down a narrow cobbled lane between yellow and white houses, and a small group of visitors follows her. She leads them past a yellow tram on rails, along a busy street with more people trailing behind, and turns back to smile at them while a stray dog trots alongside.

A woman with a red scarf rides a bicycle along a paved riverside path with a long baguette sticking out of the front wicker basket; the Eiffel Tower and a stone bridge over the river fill the background. She then walks between rows of a purple lavender field at dusk with her arms out, turning to laugh at the sky. Finally she sits under the red awning of a pavement cafe at sunset, biting into a croissant with crumbs on the paper in front of her.

A red-haired woman in a bright green raincoat opens a series of ever grander gates. First a low white picket gate in a cottage flower garden, then a heavy wooden farm gate with sheep grazing behind it, then tall black iron gates opening onto an avenue of clipped hedges. Finally she grips a huge gold-painted gate and looks through it at an enormous stately palace, then turns to the camera smiling with the palace and its wide gravel forecourt behind her.

A travel selfie video. A man with a backpack films himself grinning in front of the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, its columns and bronze horse statue above him and cyclists crossing the square behind. The scene cuts to him leaning on a stone parapet in the mountains, looking across a pine forest at a white fairy-tale castle half hidden in mist. Finally he is inside a festival beer tent strung with lights, where men in traditional jackets and hats hold up stone beer mugs and a giant pretzel while he raises a mug of his own to the camera.

A young woman with a large trekking backpack walks in through the open door of a hostel and up to the front desk, where a member of staff stands behind the counter in a small room lined with leaflets, posters and a drinks fridge. Next she is at a huge painted world map on the wall, laughing as she presses a small marker onto it. She then walks into a dorm room with wooden bunk beds and a locker, greeted by two other travellers on the bunks. Finally she steps onto a rooftop terrace at sunset where friends are sitting at a wooden table, and the group eats a big pan of paella together as the sun goes down over the city.

A three-tier montage of places to stay. A young backpacker with a big rucksack leans out of the doorway of a shabby wooden roadside place under a pink and blue neon HOTEL sign. Cut to a woman in a grey suit wheeling a silver suitcase out of a revolving glass door into a bright marble lobby, with the caption 150 EUR over her. Cut to an elderly man in a dark suit with a walking stick greeted by a uniformed doorman in front of a floodlit palace facade with a fountain, then walking through a chandelier-lit marble hall, caption 2,000 EUR.

A young man with bleached hair in a blue rain jacket stands at a wire fence beside an airfield under a clear sky, filming himself with a gull perched on a fence post in front of him. A small white propeller plane comes down and touches its wheels on the runway behind him. Then a huge four-engine airliner drops in very low right over his head, wheels out, and lands on the runway; he turns to watch it, throws both fists in the air and shouts in delight.

A packed floodlit football stadium at night. A young man in the foreground has his face painted half light blue and half white, the colours of his country, and wears the same light-blue-and-white striped shirt and a matching scarf. He hammers a big drum strapped to his chest while the whole stand around him sings and jumps in the same colours. Scarves are held up overhead, and then a huge light-blue-and-white flag is passed over the crowd until it covers the whole frame; he looks up at it, still shouting.

A young man in an orange jacket stands with both arms spread wide on a cobbled square in front of a twin-towered brick church while a flock of pigeons flies up around him, then looks back at the camera from a wooden fence above a bright turquoise lake ringed with pine trees and mountains, then sits at a wooden table in a log restaurant behind a big white plate stacked with browned dumplings and forks them into his mouth with wide eyes.

Under the glass roof of a big railway station a family waits on the platform: a father in a cap, a mother in tears and a teenage son holding up a hand-drawn welcome sign, trains standing at the platforms behind them. A young woman with a rucksack and a duffel bag comes running out through the Arrivals doorway, drops her bag and throws herself into their arms. The four of them stand hugging on the platform, crying and laughing.

Outside a wooden mountain hut, a young man in an embroidered folk shirt, leather belt and a black felt hat with a feather cooks an old country dish over a fire. He scrapes small dumplings off a wooden board into a big black cauldron of boiling water, holds up a white lump of sheep cheese, sprinkles fried bacon over the pot and stirs it with a wooden spoon. He then serves the finished dish in a carved wooden bowl on a rough wooden table and grins at the camera while hikers watch from the hut behind him.

A young woman with a camera round her neck browses a souvenir stall on a Paris riverside. She picks up a small metal Eiffel Tower, then lifts a snow globe with a tower inside and looks at it up close. In the last shots she holds a large woven straw basket with two round handles, loaded with metal towers, fridge magnets and postcards, while an older woman behind the stall puts a red beret on her head.

A young woman stands in a souvenir kiosk hung with racks of picture cards, holding up a small metal Eiffel Tower keychain while the smiling stallholder watches. She holds a snow globe up against the sky by the river, then tries on a red and a navy beret in front of a mirror. At the end she carries two straw baskets and a thick fan of picture cards showing Paris landmarks, spreading them out towards the camera.

A price caption rises with every scene. At 10 euros a backpacker climbs barefoot onto a metal bunk in a crowded hostel dormitory. At 100 euros a woman in a suit opens the door of a bright hotel room with a city view and walks in past the big white bed. At 10,000 euros an older couple step out through glass doors onto the deck of an overwater villa with a glass floor over turquoise water, then sit together on the bed above the sea, laughing.

A travel montage. A red-haired woman films herself from the wicker basket of a hot air balloon at dawn over Cappadocia, with dozens of striped balloons drifting at different heights above the rock valley and its stone spires. The clip then cuts to a covered bazaar lined with blue patterned ceramics and hanging glass lamps, where her finger points at the shelves, and finally to her on a ferry deck at dusk sipping a tulip glass of Turkish tea while gulls fly past over the water.

On a sunny paved city square with a big fountain, trees and tall old apartment buildings, a young woman with long black hair, in a light blue T-shirt and cream skirt, holds a large open street map and turns her other palm up, looking puzzled at a young man in a brown jumper and dark trousers. He is walking a small brown dachshund on a lead, stops, leans over the map and points at a spot on it while she smiles. A café table stands in front and other people walk across the square.

Seen from the viewer's point of view in a narrow old street at sunset. One of the viewer's hands holds a backpack strap and wears a red braided bracelet, the other is held out open. A smiling young man in a white T-shirt sits on a pale blue scooter and points down the street with his arm stretched out, then puts his hands back on the handlebars and smiles at the viewer as the view moves closer. Yellow houses with flower-filled balconies line both sides, with shops selling woven baskets and colourful cloth.

On a sunny tropical beach, a young man in a white office shirt with a loose navy tie and light blue swim shorts lies barefoot in a white rope hammock between palm trees, smiling and drinking from a green coconut with a straw. He then leans his head back, closes his eyes and relaxes. A blue suitcase stands by a palm trunk, and a brown dog sleeps on the sand below him. Behind is a colourful wooden beach bar with string lights and hanging coconuts, and turquoise sea.

In the sandy arena of a huge ancient stone amphitheatre, with rows of golden arches and stone seats curving all around under a pale blue sky with thin clouds, a young woman with curly dark hair, in a mustard blouse, a flowing white skirt and sandals, spins round and round with her arms out, laughing, her skirt swirling. She stays right in the middle of the empty arena, inside a large circle drawn in the sand, and small birds fly high above the walls.

In a busy old bus station under a glass and iron roof on a sunny day, a shaggy brown dog wearing a small pack leaps off a wooden bench. A young man with long wavy hair, a cap, a khaki T-shirt and shorts swings a canvas backpack onto his shoulder, walks to a white coach and climbs in through its door, and the dog trots after him. An old man sleeps with his head back on a seat by the bench. Travellers with rolling suitcases, a woman holding flowers, a closed kiosk and pigeons fill the platform.

On a station platform between two trains at dusk, a young woman in a camel coat and trousers with a guitar case on her back leaps across the platform from one train door to the other, sunglasses in her hair, while a glove, an apple and a spilled paper cup lie behind her. She lands on the step of the right train and holds on to its door, looking back. A conductor leans out of the left train, and travellers with a suitcase, a potted plant and a dog walk along the platform behind.

On a lake shore under a stormy sky with dark pine forest behind, a young man in a green fleece and shorts wades knee-deep through the water with a bundle of camping gear under one arm: a rolled mat, a guitar case, a kettle, a yellow rubber duck and a folding chair. He grabs a floating sun hat and puts it on his head, then a boot slips out of the bundle and splashes into the water, and he laughs. A collapsed green tent lies on a rock, a red cool box floats nearby and friends wade behind.

A young woman in a straw hat, white shirt and denim shorts stands with a rolling suitcase in a narrow cobbled lane of whitewashed houses with blue doors, seen from under a white arch on a sunny day. She looks around, confused, while an older man in a doorway points down the lane with both hands and a woman leans on a balcony railing above. She then unfolds a paper map and studies it with a smile. Potted plants line the walls, washing hangs from a window, and a ginger cat sits on the cobbles near pink flowers.

A smiling young woman in khaki travel clothes with a large backpack walks through a bright ferry terminal with big glass windows and a white ferry docked outside. She holds her passport up to her mouth, then looks down at the phone in her hand as she walks on. Behind her a queue of travellers with suitcases and backpacks files through the boarding gate, a couple hugs by the window, a young man sits on the floor beside a guitar case, and a porter pushes a luggage trolley.

A laughing young woman with long dark hair sits by the open window of an old, colourful bus driving along a mountain road above green rice terraces. She holds a straw hat on her head and laughs, then takes it off and holds it in her lap, while a white goat pokes its head in through the window beside her. Tassels and flowers decorate the luggage rack above, which is piled with sacks. Other passengers sit behind her, and a basket of mangoes sits on the seat in front.

A smiling young man in sunglasses and a navy suit leaps into the air towards the infinity pool of a sunny luxury beach resort with palm trees and a turquoise sea, his tie flying up. He splashes into the water, his rolling suitcase falls over on the stone edge, and he ends up floating on his back with his arms spread wide, still in his suit and brown leather shoes. A laughing waiter in white holds a tray with a coconut drink and a flower garland, and guests lie on sun loungers behind.

A laughing young couple ride one red bicycle across a large cobbled square in the evening, in front of a grand baroque church with two bell towers lit by string lights. A young man in a green T-shirt pedals and looks up at the church, while a young woman sits behind him and looks up too. They ride towards the camera as a pigeon flies off, past a dropped ice cream cone lying on the cobbles. A street painter with an easel, a horse and carriage, tourists and cafe tables with umbrellas fill the square.

Inside a camper van parked in the desert. A young woman with her hair in a bun, a beige T-shirt and a head torch holds a small torch in her mouth and quickly stuffs a grey towel into a big backpack with a water bottle in its side pocket, then closes it, swings it onto her shoulder and stands up. A rolled sleeping mat lies next to her. A black and white dog comes in through the side door carrying a hiking boot, while outside a huge wall of sand blows closer.

An airport arrivals hall at night. A young man in a navy jacket walks in pulling a black suitcase. A young woman in a cream jumper and jeans runs to him, leaps into his arms and hugs him tightly, holding a bunch of pink and yellow tulips, while his suitcase falls over. On the stone floor lie the signs of a long wait: a stack of empty paper coffee cups, a half-eaten sandwich, a crumpled coat and a neck pillow. A porter pushes luggage trolleys past the sliding doors behind.

A paraglider flies high over a bay, the viewer's hands holding the steering handles and brown boots hanging below. The flight passes right over a tall red tower of a suspension bridge and continues along the bridge, with cars driving on its deck far below. The long red bridge spans the water to green hills on the far shore above a thick layer of white fog. Other colourful paragliders in yellow, turquoise and red float nearby in the pale golden light.

A busy Asian market street lined with red paper lanterns and food stalls. The sun is rising low at the far end of the street, its bright light shining straight down the lane. A young man with a big backpack walks down the middle towards the rising sun, and a young man beside him raises his arm and points ahead down the street. A smiling vendor in a red apron hands food to a young woman at a stall with steaming pots, and scooters are parked along the side.

A luxury hotel room at night, with wooden walls, a marble floor and a snowy city outside the window. A golden retriever in a white bathrobe jumps up happily onto the big white bed, tossing pillows into the air, then rolls onto its back and wriggles with its paws in the air. In the doorway a cat dressed as a bellhop, in a burgundy uniform and cap, stands behind a brass luggage trolley stacked with old suitcases. A green armchair and a rust rug are in the room.

A sunny rooftop hotel pool under a clear blue sky. In front a young woman in a blue swimsuit lies back on a pastel inflatable ring with her eyes closed and a drink in her hand, smiling and completely relaxed. A man swims underwater beneath her, splashing, and then comes up behind her ring, while she gives a thumbs up without opening her eyes. Around the pool a young woman and man toss a beach ball, people lounge on sunbeds and striped cabanas stand under strings of lights.
